name: Anna's Wedding Planning & Consulting
primary_cta: Request your wedding date (booking request summary + tap to call Nassau or the US line)
brand_truth: One experienced Bahamian planner, Annamae Fox, two decades of beach and cruise-day weddings in Nassau, published prices from USD 875, the licence paperwork handled.
buyer: US, Canadian and international couples planning a Nassau beach or cruise-day wedding on a phone months ahead; fear licence mistakes, a planner who stops answering, hidden costs.

direction.type: T09 Didone fashion (Bodoni Moda + Jost, self-hosted)
direction.why: The five kinds of wedding with prices become a permanent index that swaps Anna's own photograph, so the buyer's real question (which package, what price) is the structure. Shallow-water aqua and sand are the colours of every photo she owns. A Didone is bridal-magazine type, more refined than Gloock + Figtree. P03 conch pink refused: Bahamas Bridal Affairs (competitor) uses it.

concept_type: packages with booking request (no cart, no payment; verified on /book-now)
big_idea: The offer is the index: Anna's five kinds of wedding sit in a permanent left index like a bridal atelier's catalogue; touch one and her own photograph of that wedding fills the page, and the package finder turns how you arrive and who comes into one published price.

critic.by: independent critic mode 2, after one fix pass

critic_kind: independent critic scored pass 1 (above); fix pass 2 applied, not yet re-scored. Left at needs-review: Anna's own photos are 2015 web-size files, and the hero portrait is upscaled to about 900 px, so photography may still score 3.
current_site_findings: Booking form and package pages disagree on three prices (Romantic 3,295 vs 3,995; Blue Ocean 6,645 vs 7,645; Tropical 10,595 vs 13,895).
Cultural, Deluxe and Renewal prices exist only inside booking-form dropdowns.
Best photo (2025 rose arbor) buried; homepage slider uses faded composite banners and repeats 'Dream Wedding Services'.
Most photos date from 2015 and load over http.
Cruise purser-letter rule on a separate page; no email or WhatsApp published.
pitch_line: Your fifteen packages, one honest price list and your own best photographs, arranged so a couple abroad finds their package and asks for their date in two taps.
assumptions: Package-page prices used where the booking form disagrees (Romantic 3,995, Blue Ocean 7,645, Tropical 13,895): confirm which is current.
Cultural, Deluxe and Renewal prices from the booking form; inclusions not published.
Annamae Fox is the Anna of the business (Instagram profile name).
Both phone numbers current; which takes WhatsApp unknown; no email published.
Licence rules as published by Anna; confirm with the Registrar General.
The vow renewal photo in the index is a generic Anna wedding photo (her Blue Ocean package image), not a renewal.
notes: Gen-2 rebuild 2026-11-20, kept the gen-1 structure Balazs liked (package finder with arrival mode and guest slider, licence checklist, published prices, date request) and rebuilt everything else: Bodoni Moda + Jost self-hosted (replaces Gloock + Figtree), fixed left index of the five wedding kinds that swaps the hero photo on hover, bigger photography (half-screen hero, 78svh spread), aqua field for licence and footer. BLIND: look.mjs, Wikimedia and outside images blocked; Anna's photos were seen through a Lovable contact-sheet project (ip-assets-anna-wedding, about 1.5 Lovable credits, no generation) and its screenshot crops were routed into Playwright for my own QA screenshots (low-res crops, the real hero is 2560px). No reference screenshots (blocked); references judged from knowledge (aesop.com index, belmond weddings). No subagent tool was available, so the critic step was a self-critique: first pass found repetitive 5/7 two-column rhythm and a CTA ('Check your wedding date') identical to Bahamas Bridal Affairs; fixed (licence restructured full-width with two-column checklist, CTA now 'Request your wedding date'), re-shot and re-scored. State is needs-review because no independent critic scored it. qa.mjs dead-space blocker is a false positive: the index column is position:fixed and full height on every screen, but a full-page screenshot draws it only once at the top. qa tap-target warning is the shared concept ribbon button. interact.mjs 'dead input' is the range slider receiving text input (works with real input). No 3D (standard tier). Fix pass 1 (after independent critic 3/3/3/3/4/3/2): see fix_passes. Full-page screenshots for the critic are stitched from viewport captures (pass1-*-full.png) because a fixed column only renders once at the top of a Playwright full-page capture; the qa.mjs dead-space blocker remains for the same reason. Fix pass 2 applied after independent re-score 3/4/3/4/4/4/3; pass2-* screenshots in factory/qa/anna-s-wedding-planning-consulting/ (stitched from viewport captures, photo crops routed in). | 2026-11-21 final check: independent critic (mode 2) first scored photo 2, comp 3, refs 3 (hero blew up a small 2015 snapshot to half the screen; index hidden as tabs). One fix pass: hero photo is now a framed captioned plate (max 480 px) on a sand panel opening on the 2025 rose-arbor photo (2560 px source); the five kinds with from-prices are a full index in the hero that swaps the plate; phone shows photo, headline and CTA inside 844 px; mobile bottom padding keeps the sticky CTA and concept label off content. Re-score: photo 3, refs 3, rest 4. Left needs-review. Remaining: the section under the hero opens on an old snapshot shown large (shrink to plate size), desktop sand panel empty under the plate, packages page Cultural/Deluxe/Renewals are thin blocks, native date input unstyled.

changes: Index column is the whole system: fixed full height on every screen of both pages, lit entry follows scroll (IntersectionObserver), USD prices in a two-column grid that cannot misalign, sentence-case italic labels instead of tracked caps.
Hero: headline 'Married barefoot in Nassau.' beside a full-height photo at 62% of the content width, recropped so the groom's face reads; no empty middle column, no widow, Bodoni tracking -0.045em.

One spread per wedding kind: beach and cruise as the package finder (photo 60%, price large in Bodoni with USD and tabular figures, inclusions as a two-column editorial list without icons); cultural, deluxe and renewal as alternating 60/40 spreads with large Bodoni price lists. Three-column card grid removed.
All tracked uppercase eyebrows removed; the mint band now only on the licence section (footer is ground with a hairline).
Mobile first screen: headline, 'Request your wedding date' and 'Call Anna' inside 844 px, photo after; scrolling chip nav has a fade mask and an arrow and its lit chip follows scroll.
Packages page rebuilt to match: 60/40 spreads, editorial inclusion lists, no checkmarks, no card grid.

Hero is now full-bleed: photo is exactly 62% of the viewport (x 547 to 1440), full height, bleeding right; it leads with the smiling couple at the sea (faces read). The index column slides in after the hero and stays pinned for the rest of the page.
One warm grade on every photograph (CSS sepia .14, saturate .9, contrast 1.04); crops set per photo on faces, 4:5 for vertical slots; sized tinted placeholders with a fade-in on load (checklist A19).

Home cut to five screens: hero (about line folded in), package finder, licence, gallery, request. Kind spreads, About and FAQ moved off the home page; FAQ now on packages; cultural, deluxe and renewal index links go to packages.html.
Packages page: white strips and repeated slivers removed (they came from screenshot crops and sticky photos in stitched captures; photos are no longer sticky).
Phone: the concept label now sits above the 'Request your date' bar via --concept-offset (64 px). The label's compact state after scrolling is assets/concept.js shared behaviour, not changed here.
